captions.caption: This image, taken from the Northern Hemisphere (France), shows the waxing gibbous Moon. During this lunar phase, we see most of the Moon's illuminated half with the unilluminated half only appearing as a dark crescent on the left. This phase comes after first quarter moon (sometimes called half moon) and before full moon.
captions.alt_text: The Moon is mostly illuminated but a thin crescent on the left side of the Moon is in darkness

captions.alt_text: The Moon is mostly illuminated but a thin crescent on the right side of the Moon is in darkness
